title: A morphism between affine schemes is affine (Stacks 01SH)
statement: Let $f:U\to X$ be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme] with $U$ and $X$ affine. Then $f$ is an affine morphism [pqf-def-affine-morphism]: the preimage of every affine open of $X$ is affine.
